Patient_Actor.history: A 73-year-old male presents to the the clinic with lumbar pain and symmetrical bone pain in his legs and arms. He has trouble going up to his bedroom on the second floor and getting up from a chair. Past medical history reveals that he has had acid reflux for the past 5 years that is refractory to medications (PPIs & H2 antagonists); thus, he had decided to stay away from foods which have previously given him heartburn - red meats, whole milk, salmon - and has eaten a mainly vegetarian diet.
